title: Bounds on the reciprocal block count
statement: Let $\delta\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0<\delta\leq\tfrac12$, and let $m=\max\{0,\lfloor\delta^{-1}\rfloor\}$. Then $$2\leq m,\qquad m\leq\delta^{-1},\qquad \frac{\delta^{-1}}2\leq m.$$
replaced:
For every real $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq1/2$, the natural number $m=\lfloor1/\delta\rfloor$ satisfies
\[
2\leq m,\qquad m\leq\frac1\delta,\qquad \frac1{2\delta}\leq m.
\]
